items.name: location_tracking

items.name: notifications

items.name: payroll_advances

items.name: payroll_runs

items.name: pms_tasks

items.name: po_foc_entries

items.name: po_items
items.business_function: PO Items (item-wise data for each PO / Business Book entry)

items.name: proj_contractor_ra_bills
items.business_function: Contractor RA Bill — exactly 3 states per mam's flowchart: raised → payment → paid. Deductions are per-bill (retention, TDS, advance recovery, custom) so they live in a child table.

items.name: proj_daily_wage_entries
items.business_function: L2 Daily Wage entries. kind'legacy' → one bulk row for pre-ERP daily-wage payout. kind'entry' → ongoing payout: per_day_rate × days_required.

items.name: proj_mb_sheets
items.business_function: Measurement Book (CDPR) — header + line snapshot so a finalised MB stays immutable even when the underlying DPR rows are later edited. Locking is a one-way action.

items.name: proj_muster_roll
items.business_function: Muster Roll — per-day per-labourer attendance. Distinct from the existing dpr_manpower (trade-aggregate) and attendance (per-employee) tables; this is the on-site daily wage register.

items.name: proj_projects
items.business_function: L1 Salary → proj_salary_entries L2 Daily Wages → proj_daily_wage_entries L3 Sub-contract → proj_work_orders + amount_paid running Budget SUM of all three.

items.name: proj_salary_entries
items.business_function: L1 Salary entries. kind'legacy' → one bulk row at project kickoff capturing pre-ERP salary already spent. kind'monthly' → optional per-month rows captured going forward (employee_name + period_month).

items.name: proj_work_orders
items.business_function: Work Orders — dynamic count per project (NEVER hardcode 13). Phase-1 amend (mam): project_id now FKs proj_projects, plus work_order_file_url for the uploaded WO document and amount_paid for the running paid-against-value total. items.name: project_finance
items.business_function: Project Finance (manual fields for cash flow tracker)

items.name: push_subscriptions

items.name: rent_requests
items.business_function: Per-month rent requests — site engineer fills in landlord details + Aadhar + outside photo + bank/UPI + month and submits. Admin / accountant approves → paid. Designed as a self-contained payment workflow (separate from the property/booking entity model).

items.name: rental_bookings
items.business_function: Booking an occupant stay. Multiple occupants can share a room (each gets their own row with rent_share splitting the room cost).

items.name: rental_payments
items.business_function: Monthly rent payments paid to landlord

items.name: rental_properties
items.business_function: Rental properties — flats / houses / guest-houses we rent for staff accommodation (site engineers / supervisors stationed at project locations). One row per property, agreement-level info.

items.name: rental_rooms

items.name: sales_bill_items
items.business_function: Line items for a sales bill (snapshot from the Business Book order).

items.name: sales_bill_status_log
items.business_function: Status / approval audit trail for a sales bill.

items.name: sales_bills
items.business_function: Sales Bills (to client). The 4-type sequential columns (bill_type, business_book_id, …) are added by migration so the legacy rows used by the delivery-note flow keep working.

items.name: sales_funnel_audit
items.business_function: Sales Funnel — universal stage audit log per mam's spec: 'every stage entry timestamp · actor (user_id) · action · evidence (file/note) · stage exit timestamp'. items.name: score_entries

items.name: score_user_kpi_target

items.name: statutory_dues_calendar

Seeded with 4 default rows at 0 so the structure exists; admin sets real amounts via SQL or a future Finance Settings UI.

items.name: stock_balance
